This '''clone trooper''' accompanied [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Rii'ke En]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]], after engaging the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Core ship|''Lucrehulk''-class core ship]] ''[[Gahenna]]''. They were searching for the [[Scientific Instrument Package]], which contained data on the virus [[Trihexalophine1138]]. He was killed by [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] guards in the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Honoghr Rakatan temple|temple]] where the SIP was taken.<ref name="SWR 68" />
